about: The organisation's audit log: who changed a repository's visibility, a branch protection, a member's role, a token or a deploy key, and from which address. GitHub Enterprise Cloud organisations only; other plans have no audit log API.

params.org: the organisation's login, as in github.com/ORG

credentials.github-audit-token: A fine-grained personal access token, or a classic one with read:audit_log and nothing else, made by an organisation owner. It is sent as a bearer token to api.github.com only.

manifest.name: github
manifest.note: Read from where the last read stopped, oldest first. GitHub writes the time as milliseconds since the epoch and takes it back as a date inside the search phrase.
